priya.text: So you took the nursing home job.
long term care home. 7 months. nadia's directing. it's real money for once

i'm a delight now
You're something.
priya

Oh, love. Do you want me to come get you?
no i'm ok. i just wanted to say it to someone. he's called alden. he told me about the 1971 dock strike for an hour and then asked me if his wife had been in yet. she died in 2011

not like this

i can't put it in a text

Something like what.
something you'd have to tell the police
Wren.
there was a woman in 1971. colleen. i looked her up. she's real. she was never found
Ok. Ok. Don't do anything tonight. Don't email anyone. Come here tomorrow after your shift and bring the headphones and we'll listen together and then we'll decide.
ok
he said she had her mother's ring on. why would you remember that. why would that be the thing
Because he's been looking at it for fifty-five years. Go to sleep.
I've been thinking about it all day and I keep landing in the same place. It's not yours to keep and it's not yours to bury. You have to give it to someone whose job it is.

It is 2am for you. Please go home.
i'm home. i posted it on the forum. they say ducts

alden died this morning
I'm sorry. I know that's complicated.
he was asleep. the nurse said it was quiet. i was in the corridor with the mics up and i didn't record it. i turned everything off
That was the right thing.
the hum stopped a few days ago. after they did the ceiling. i know it's the ceiling
It is the ceiling. Come here tonight. I made too much dal, which is a lie, but come anyway.
derek furey emailed me. the son. he wants all the recordings of his dad. 'for the family'
Does he know what's on them?
i don't think so. alden said derek doesn't know. but he wants all of it and he wants it deleted after and he's being very polite in a way i don't like
Say no politely. Loop in Colin. Don't do this by yourself.
lawyer letter. hanley & roche. 'cease and desist from any use, distribution or retention of recordings of the late alden furey'. they want written confirmation of destruction within 14 days
They can't make you destroy evidence of a crime. That's literally the thing they can't do.
i know. colin's lawyer says the same. it's the tone. it's like they know
Then act like they know. Kavanagh gets a copy this week. Maureen gets your letter. And you make a plan for your own self, because I've watched you make plans for everyone else for six months.
sent it to maureen
How do you feel.
like i mailed someone a bomb with a nice note
You mailed someone the truth. It's the same feeling. That's not your fault.
someone was in my apartment
WHAT

i was at the co-op for 40 min. door was locked when i got back. the mixpre is gone and the backup drive from the desk. the thinkpad's fine, it was in my bag. nothing else touched. my jewelry is right there
Call the police. Right now. Then call me.
i called. they're coming 'within a few hours'. it was a clean lock. no marks. dave says nobody asked him for a key
I'm coming over.
no. don't. i don't want you here if they come back. i have a thing i've been building. i'm going to finish it tonight
The witness thing? Wren, that was a joke. You said it was a joke.
it was 60% a joke
if someone texts you from my whatsapp and it's not me, it's a witness. be nice. don't be too nice
I hate this. I hate this so much. Text me every hour.
still here. it's seeding. 0 peers. i feel insane
You are a bit insane. Keep going.
going to mom's. don't text this number for a bit, i'm leaving the phone here. i'll find you.
Ok. Ok. I love you. Drive carefully. Text me from a payphone like it's 1971.
Too soon. Sorry. Go.
